checks: Actual stopped Box task resumes the same source/run, preserves its complete original prefix and reproduces every checked appearance and later prediction.

External OTB boxes plus source-only AI visibility frozen through actual import controls before each tracking task. Labels never enter tracking. Existing legacy-flow default remains selected initially.

Six actual Java runs: four candidate windows plus incumbent and prior-bank Box controls. All570 tracker/filter samples equal frozen evidence; independent host overlap, admission-correctness and distractor arithmetic match. Native world remains unchanged.

Source overlays, visible/partial states, appearance provenance and independent admission verdicts displayed at1100/1600 without page overflow. Label and audit exports match their immutable records; exact label reimport preserves identity.

Any fully visible reference-supported admissions retained/exported from original source pixels. Empty/unsupported sets refused. All retained sets reverified after restart; no feedback into measured tracking.
Abrupt owned-Java termination and cold restart retain all six original runs, labels, association proofs and untouched native world. Reopening actual saved comparison recomputes the same result.
Actual cost control reports all-byte hashing and exact-byte structural reuse; full source/outcome checks, defaults and scene unchanged.

audit.scope: Independent target boxes and separately declared visibility score original runs. IoU failure is not automatically an identity switch. Distractor match requires overlap with an independently labelled other object. Missing and uncertain labels remain explicit; no physical or personal identity certification.

dataset.license: Public research benchmark; original authors/source retain rights. Local research; no raw JPEG/ZIP redistribution. Limited attributed app screenshots.
dataset.source: Visual Tracker Benchmark / Yi Wu, Ming-Hsuan Yang, Jongwoo Lim; https://rvlab.snu.ac.kr/research/tracker_benchmark; consecutive original JPEG bytes. Real camera recording.
dataset.title: OTB box-535 later camera cover and return

input.provenance: External original OTB boxes converted from one-based XYWH to normalized corners. Only the first source box initializes tracking. Every selected image reviewed source-only after algorithm/scorer lock, before predictions. AI visibility is not independent human adjudication. No labelled distractors supplied. later camera cover and return. No real full out-of-frame return. Rendered Bird1 transitions remain uncertain; existing scorer does not bridge uncertain intervals into recovery delay.

input.provenance: External original OTB boxes converted from one-based XYWH to normalized corners. Only the first source box initializes tracking. Every selected image reviewed source-only after algorithm/scorer lock, before predictions. AI visibility is not independent human adjudication. No labelled distractors supplied. later camera partial cover. No real full out-of-frame return. Rendered Bird1 transitions remain uncertain; existing scorer does not bridge uncertain intervals into recovery delay.

input.provenance: External original OTB boxes converted from one-based XYWH to normalized corners. Only the first source box initializes tracking. Rendered Bird1 transitions remain uncertain; existing scorer does not bridge uncertain intervals into recovery delay.
